title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 351–400 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Would you like sugar with your black tea?
examples.zh: 你的紅茶要加糖嗎？

examples.en: Consuming too much added sugar is harmful to your overall health.
examples.zh: 攝取過多添加糖對你的整體健康有害。

examples.en: Sugar cane was historically an important cash crop in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 甘蔗在歷史上曾是台灣南部重要的經濟作物。

examples.en: Add a pinch of salt to the vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 在蔬菜湯裡加一小撮鹽。

examples.en: Traditional salted duck eggs taste rich with warm congee.
examples.zh: 傳統鹹鴨蛋配熱粥吃起來風味濃郁。

examples.en: Salt was once as valuable as gold in ancient trading routes.
examples.zh: 在古代貿易路線上，鹽曾一度如同黃金般珍貴。

examples.en: Black pepper adds a nice aroma to fried chicken.
examples.zh: 黑胡椒能為炸雞增添香氣。

examples.en: Stir-fry green bell peppers with sliced beef for a tasty dinner.
examples.zh: 用青椒炒牛肉片是一道美味的晚餐佳餚。

examples.en: Sprinkle freshly ground black pepper on the creamy pasta.
examples.zh: 在奶油義大利麵上撒上現磨黑胡椒。

examples.en: A hot bowl of corn soup warms you up quickly.
examples.zh: 一碗熱騰騰的玉米濃湯能讓你迅速暖和。

examples.en: Taiwanese beef noodle soup has won international culinary awards.
examples.zh: 台灣牛肉麵在國際美食界屢獲殊榮。

examples.en: Grandmother simmered chicken soup with ginger for three hours.
examples.zh: 奶奶用老薑慢火燉煮了三小時的雞湯。

examples.en: I usually have a fresh fruit salad for brunch.
examples.zh: 我早午餐通常吃一份新鮮水果沙拉。

examples.en: A crisp vegetable salad with olive oil dressing makes a light dinner.
examples.zh: 淋上橄欖油醬汁的爽脆蔬菜沙拉是一頓清爽的晚餐。

examples.en: The chef tossed the salad with crunchy croutons and parmesan cheese.
examples.zh: 主廚在沙拉中拌入了香脆的麵包丁與帕瑪森起司。

examples.en: Mom packed a ham and egg sandwich for my lunch.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我的午餐準備了火腿蛋三明治。

examples.en: He ordered a toasted chicken club sandwich with a cup of black coffee.
examples.zh: 他點了一份烤雞肉總匯三明治搭配一杯黑咖啡。

examples.en: Sandwiches are convenient snacks to pack for outdoor hiking trips.
examples.zh: 三明治是外出健行旅行時便於攜帶的點心。

examples.en: He ordered a beef burger and french fries.
examples.zh: 他點了一份牛肉漢堡和薯條。

examples.en: Homemade hamburgers taste much healthier when made with fresh lean meat.
examples.zh: 用新鮮瘦肉自製的漢堡吃起來健康得多。

examples.en: Our school festival had a popular food stall selling mini hamburgers.
examples.zh: 我們學校園遊會有一個販賣迷你漢堡的人氣攤位。

examples.en: We shared a large seafood pizza at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在聚會上分吃了一個大份海鮮披薩。

examples.en: Wood-fired pizza has a delightfully crispy and smoky crust.
examples.zh: 柴燒窯烤披薩擁有令人愉悅的酥脆焦香餅皮。

examples.en: My little brother can finish three whole slices of cheese pizza by himself.
examples.zh: 我弟弟一個人就能吃光整整三片起司披薩。

examples.en: We bought a chocolate birthday cake for Lucy.
examples.zh: 我們為露西買了一個巧克力生日蛋糕。

examples.en: Solving this basic algebra problem is a piece of cake for him.
examples.zh: 解開這道基礎代數題目對他來說簡直易如反掌。

examples.en: She decorated the strawberry shortcake with whipped cream and fresh mint leaves.
examples.zh: 她用鮮奶油與新鮮薄荷葉點綴草莓蛋糕。

examples.en: Freshly baked chocolate chip cookies smell great.
examples.zh: 現烤的巧克力豆餅乾聞起來好香。

examples.en: We baked buttery sugar cookies together during the Christmas holidays.
examples.zh: 聖誕假期我們一起烤了濃郁奶油糖霜餅乾。

examples.en: Keep your cookies in an airtight jar so they stay crunchy and fresh.
examples.zh: 把餅乾保存在密封罐裡，才能保持酥脆新鮮。

examples.en: Eating too much candy is not good for your teeth.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果對你的牙齒不好。

examples.en: Children were thrilled to catch sweet candies during the festival parade.
examples.zh: 節慶遊行時孩子們開心地接著拋灑下來的甜美糖果。

examples.en: The old candy shop has sold traditional handmade sweets for fifty years.
examples.zh: 這家古老的糖果行販售傳統手工糖果已有五十年歷史。

examples.en: Mango ice cream is extremely popular in summer.
examples.zh: 芒果冰淇淋在夏天非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Two scoops of vanilla ice cream melted over the warm waffle.
examples.zh: 兩球香草冰淇淋在溫熱的鬆餅上漸漸融化。

examples.en: Nothing beats a cold ice cream cone on a scorching hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日午後，沒有什麼比來上一支冰涼甜筒更棒的了。

examples.en: Watermelons in Hualien are juicy and sweet.
examples.zh: 花蓮的西瓜多汁又香甜。

examples.en: It was very sweet of you to remember my grandmother's birthday.
examples.zh: 你能記得我奶奶的生日，真是太貼心了。

examples.en: He has a major sweet tooth and loves cakes, puddings, and chocolates.
examples.zh: 他是個不折不扣的甜食愛好者，超愛蛋糕、布丁和巧克力。

examples.en: Salted crispy chicken is a must-try night market snack.
examples.zh: 鹹酥雞是必嚐的夜市小吃。

examples.en: This seaweed soup tastes a little bit too salty; please add some water.
examples.zh: 這碗海帶湯喝起來有點太鹹了，請加點水。

examples.en: Sea water is salty because it contains dissolved minerals and salts.
examples.zh: 海水之所以是鹹的，是因為含有溶解的礦物質與鹽分。

examples.en: Fresh lemon juice tastes quite sour without honey.
examples.zh: 不加蜂蜜的新鮮檸檬汁喝起來蠻酸的。

examples.en: Sweet and sour pork is a popular dish on Chinese restaurant menus.
examples.zh: 糖醋里肌是中式餐館菜單上的人氣料理。

examples.en: Unripe green plums have a very sharp, sour punch.
examples.zh: 未成熟的青梅酸味強勁刺激。

examples.en: Good medicine often tastes bitter.
examples.zh: 良藥往往苦口。

examples.en: Bitter melon is prized in Taiwanese home cooking for its cooling health benefits.
examples.zh: 苦瓜在台灣家常菜中因其清退火的養生功效而備受喜愛。

examples.en: The hikers endured bitter cold winds while ascending the mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 登山者在攀登稜線時忍受著刺骨的嚴寒風雪。

examples.en: Taiwanese spicy hot pot is full of rich flavor.
examples.zh: 台灣麻辣鍋風味濃郁。

examples.en: Kimchi adds a tangy and spicy kick to fried rice.
examples.zh: 泡菜為炒飯增添了微酸辛辣的風味層次。

examples.en: If you cannot tolerate spicy dishes, order the mild broth instead.
examples.zh: 如果你不太能吃辣，建議改點原味清湯湯底。

examples.en: The soup dumplings here are truly delicious.
examples.zh: 這裡的小籠包真的很美味。

examples.en: Grandmother prepared a delicious feast for the family reunion.
examples.zh: 奶奶為家族團圓準備了一頓豐盛美味的饗宴。

examples.en: Everything on the buffet table looks and smells absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 自助餐檯上的每樣佳餚看起來和聞起來都美味極了。

examples.en: I am full after eating three bowls of noodles.
examples.zh: 吃了三碗麵後我已經飽了。

examples.en: The library reading room was completely full during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週期間圖書館自習室座無虛席。

examples.en: She was full of excitement before setting off on her foreign exchange program.
examples.zh: 在出發前往海外交換學生計畫之前，她心中充滿了興奮與期待。

examples.en: The water bottle is empty; please refill it.
examples.zh: 水瓶空了，請幫忙重新裝滿。

examples.en: The classroom was empty after the final school bell rang.
examples.zh: 最後一堂放學鐘聲響過後，教室裡空無一人。

examples.en: Don't take strong medication on an empty stomach without consulting a doctor.
examples.zh: 諮詢醫生前，請勿在空腹狀態下服用強效藥物。

examples.en: Finish your homework before playing computer games.
examples.zh: 玩電腦遊戲前先把作業寫完。

examples.en: The English teacher assigned reading homework over the weekend.
examples.zh: 英文老師交代了週末的閱讀家庭作業。

examples.en: She organized her study desk so she could do her homework with full concentration.
examples.zh: 她整理好了書桌，以便全神貫注地寫作業。

examples.en: We have an English vocabulary test every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們每週五都有英文單字測驗。

examples.en: Scientists conducted several laboratory tests to verify the vaccine's safety.
examples.zh: 科學家進行了多項實驗室檢驗以確認疫苗的安全性。

examples.en: He studied hard and passed his driver's license test on the first try.
examples.zh: 他努力準備，一次就考過了汽車駕照考試。

examples.en: Ken is in the seventh grade at junior high school.
examples.zh: 肯恩就讀國中七年級。

examples.en: She was delighted to receive top grades in mathematics and physics.
examples.zh: 她在數學和物理上獲得優異成績，感到非常高興。

examples.en: The teacher spent Sunday afternoon grading student test papers.
examples.zh: 老師在週日下午批改學生的測驗試卷。

examples.en: Does anyone have any question about this grammar rule?
examples.zh: 有人對這個文法規則有任何疑問嗎？

examples.en: Remember to put a question mark at the end of every question sentence.
examples.zh: 記得在每個疑問句句末加上問號。

examples.en: The interviewers asked several thought-provoking questions about his leadership experience.
examples.zh: 面試官針對他的領導經驗提出了幾個發人深省的問題。

examples.en: Today's lesson is about environmental protection.
examples.zh: 今天的課是有關環境保護。

examples.en: We learned a valuable lesson about team cooperation during the robotics contest.
examples.zh: 我們在機器人競賽中學到了團隊合作的寶貴一課。

examples.en: She takes private piano lessons every Tuesday after school.
examples.zh: 她每週二放學後都會去上私人鋼琴課。

examples.en: Science is my favorite school subject.
examples.zh: 自然科學是我最喜歡的學科。

examples.en: The subject of today's morning assembly speech was digital safety.
examples.zh: 今天朝會演講的主題是數位網路安全。

examples.en: Every complete English sentence requires a subject and a predicate verb.
examples.zh: 每個完整的英文句子都需要主詞與謂語動詞。

examples.en: Practice makes math problems much easier.
examples.zh: 多加練習會讓數學題目容易得多。

examples.en: We will have a comprehensive math quiz covering fractions next Monday.
examples.zh: 我們下週一將舉行涵蓋分數單元的數學綜合測驗。

examples.en: Learning math strengthens your problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
examples.zh: 學習數學能強化你解決問題與批判性思維的能力。

examples.en: Speaking English with native speakers builds confidence.
examples.zh: 和母語人士說英語能建立自信。

examples.en: Our English teacher encourages us to read English storybooks every evening.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師鼓勵我們每天晚上讀英文故事書。

examples.en: English has become a global language for international science and business.
examples.zh: 英語已成為國際科學與商務領域的通用語言。

examples.en: We learn classical poetry in Chinese class.
examples.zh: 我們在國文課學習古典詩詞。

examples.en: Many international students visit Taiwan to learn traditional Chinese characters.
examples.zh: 許多國際學生造訪台灣學習繁體中文字。

examples.en: Delicious Chinese cuisine varies greatly across regional cultures.
examples.zh: 美味的中華料理在不同地域文化間展現豐富多樣的風貌。

examples.en: Science experiments in the lab are fascinating.
examples.zh: 實驗室裡的自然科學實驗很吸引人。

examples.en: Advancements in medical science have cured many previously deadly diseases.
examples.zh: 醫學科學的進步治癒了許多過往致命的疾病。

examples.en: Our school science club won the regional innovation championship.
examples.zh: 我們學校的自然科學社贏得了區域創新競賽冠軍。

examples.en: Taiwan has a rich and multicultural history.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有豐富且多元的歷史。

examples.en: We visited the National Palace Museum to learn about ancient Asian history.
examples.zh: 我們參觀國立故宮博物院以了解古代亞洲歷史。

examples.en: Studying history allows us to understand the past and build a better future.
examples.zh: 研讀歷史讓我們了解過去，進而開拓更美好的未來。

examples.en: We painted watercolors during art class today.
examples.zh: 我們今天在美術課畫了水彩畫。

examples.en: The art museum is showcasing an exhibition of modern Taiwanese oil paintings.
examples.zh: 美術館正在展出台灣現代油畫特展。

examples.en: Cooking good food is both a careful science and a creative art.
examples.zh: 烹調美食既是一門嚴謹的科學，也是一種富創意的藝術。

examples.en: We learned how to play the recorder in music class.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂課學會了吹直笛。

examples.en: Music class is on Wednesday afternoon in the audiovisual hall.
examples.zh: 音樂課在週三下午於視聽大樓舉行。

examples.en: During music class, students sang traditional Taiwanese ballads together.
examples.zh: 在音樂課上，同學們一起合唱了台灣傳統民謠。

examples.en: We played dodgeball during PE class yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在體育課玩了躲避球。

examples.en: Make sure you wear comfortable athletic shoes for PE class.
examples.zh: 上體育課時務必穿著舒適的運動球鞋。

examples.en: Regular PE classes help students stay active and physically fit.
examples.zh: 規律的體育課能幫助學生保持身心活力與體適能。

examples.en: The school gym is open for basketball practice.
examples.zh: 學校體育館開放進行籃球練習。

examples.en: Many working professionals go to the gym to work out after office hours.
examples.zh: 許多上班族下班後會到健身房健身鍛鍊。

examples.en: The school graduation ceremony took place in the air-conditioned indoor gym.
examples.zh: 學校畢業典禮在附設空調的室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: Students love running around the playground during recess.
examples.zh: 學生喜歡在下課時間在操場上奔跑。

examples.en: The municipal park built a modern inclusive playground for young children.
examples.zh: 市立公園為幼童打造了一座現代共融式遊戲場。

examples.en: Always play safely and take turns on the playground equipment.
examples.zh: 在遊樂場設施上玩耍時請注意安全並輪流使用。

examples.en: The teacher wrote the vocabulary words on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師把單字寫在黑板上。

examples.en: Dust from old chalk on the blackboard can sometimes make students sneeze.
examples.zh: 黑板上的舊粉筆灰有時會讓學生打噴嚏。

examples.en: The class monitor washed the blackboard clean at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 班長在放學前把黑板擦得乾乾淨淨。

examples.en: Please clean the whiteboard with the eraser.
examples.zh: 請用白板擦把白板擦乾淨。

examples.en: The teacher used blue and red dry-erase markers on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 老師在白板上使用了藍色和紅色的白板筆。

examples.en: In modern smart classrooms, digital whiteboards connect directly to tablets.
examples.zh: 在現代智慧教室中，數位電子白板可直接與平板電腦連線。

examples.en: I like apples and oranges.
examples.zh: 我喜歡蘋果和柳橙。

examples.en: He is smart, kind, and always willing to help his classmates.
examples.zh: 他聰明、善良，而且總是樂於幫助同學。

examples.en: You and I should cooperate closely to finish this science assignment.
examples.zh: 你和我應該緊密合作以完成這項自然科學作業。

examples.en: He worked hard, but he still needs more practice.
examples.zh: 他很努力，但仍需要更多練習。

examples.en: The shoes look stylish, but they feel rather uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋看起來時髦，但穿起來相當不舒服。

examples.en: She was nervous before giving her presentation, but she performed exceptionally well.
examples.zh: 她在簡報前很緊張，但她表現得非常出色。

examples.en: Would you like green tea or black tea?
examples.zh: 你想要喝綠茶還是紅茶？

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the morning school bus!
examples.zh: 快一點，否則我們要錯過晨間校車了！

examples.en: You can submit your homework in person or send it by email.
examples.zh: 你可以親自繳交作業，或是透過電子郵件寄送。

examples.en: It was raining heavily, so we stayed home.
examples.zh: 外面下著大雨，所以我們待在家裡。

examples.en: She practiced the violin diligently every day so that she could win the competition.
examples.zh: 她每天勤奮練習小提琴，以便能在比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: Thank you so much for your warm hospitality during my stay.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你在我借宿期間的熱情款待。

examples.en: I am studying English because I want to travel.
examples.zh: 我學英文是因為我想去旅行。

examples.en: The baseball match was postponed because of the heavy thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 棒球比賽因為猛烈的雷陣雨而延期了。

examples.en: Just because a task seems difficult does not mean it is impossible.
examples.zh: 僅僅因為一項任務看似困難，並不代表它是不可能的。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, the game will be canceled.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，比賽將會取消。

examples.en: Please let me know if you need any additional stationery.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何額外的文具，請告訴我。

examples.en: If possible, arrive at the examination venue ten minutes early.
examples.zh: 如果可能的話，請提前十分鐘抵達考場。

examples.en: She is a very polite and hardworking student.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常禮貌且用功的學生。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your thoughtful birthday present.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你貼心準備的生日禮物。

examples.en: This is the very book that my teacher recommended last semester.
examples.zh: 這本正是我的老師上學期極力推薦的那本書。

examples.en: I really appreciate your timely help.
examples.zh: 我真的很感謝你及時的幫忙。

examples.en: It is really hot and humid outside today, so drink plenty of water.
examples.zh: 今天外面真的很熱很潮濕，所以要多喝水。

examples.en: Did you really finish that five-hundred-page novel in two days?
examples.zh: 你真的在兩天內讀完了那本五百頁的小說嗎？

examples.en: This jacket is too small for me.
examples.zh: 這件夾克對我來說太小了。

examples.en: I am going to the night market tonight; do you want to come too?
examples.zh: 我今晚要去逛夜市，你也想一起來嗎？

examples.en: Don't worry too much about minor mistakes in your first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿中微小的錯誤不必太過擔憂。

examples.en: Peter likes playing baseball, and he also likes swimming.
examples.zh: 彼得喜歡打棒球，而且他也喜歡游泳。

examples.en: The mobile phone is not only stylish, but it also has a long battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機不僅外型時髦，同時電池續航力也很長。

examples.en: Regular walking not only boosts energy, but it also improves sleep quality.
examples.zh: 規律散步不僅能增進體力，也能改善睡眠品質。

examples.en: Could you please repeat that again?
examples.zh: 可以請你再重複一次嗎？

examples.en: Once again, our school choir gave a breathtaking performance.
examples.zh: 我們的學校合唱團再次帶來了令人屏息的精彩演出。

examples.en: Practice the song again and again until you can play it effortlessly.
examples.zh: 一遍又一遍地反覆練習這首曲子，直到你能毫不費力地彈奏。

examples.en: You should start preparing for the exam now.
examples.zh: 你現在就應該開始準備考試了。

examples.en: Right now, it is ten o'clock in the morning in Taipei.
examples.zh: 此時此刻，台北正是早上十點整。

examples.en: From now on, let's make an effort to speak only English in conversation club.
examples.zh: 從現在起，我們在會話社團裡要努力全程只說英語。
